about.title: About ivann
about.paragraph1: ivann exists to ensure creator value is clearly aligned, fairly negotiated, and seamlessly turned into real partnerships.
about.paragraph2: ivann is a modern platform where creators and brands come together to do real business — clearly, efficiently, and on their own terms. At its core, ivann removes the friction from partnerships. Instead of scattered messages, unclear pricing, and slow negotiations, ivann provides a structured environment where creators can present their value and brands can make direct, informed offers.
about.paragraph3: The result is simple: better alignment, faster decisions, and partnerships that actually close.
about.tagline: ivann isn't just a marketplace — it's the operating layer for creator commerce.
